title: The Ortto plugin for WordPress before 1.0.25 did not escape stored settings on its admin settings… (CVE-2026-113409)
description: The Ortto plugin for WordPress versions before 1.0.25 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability due to improper escaping of stored settings on its admin settings page. This flaw allows a threat actor with the ability to modify the plugin's configuration to execute arbitrary JavaScript in an administrator's session when the affected page is visited.
